cases.name: baseline
cases.what: in distribution: the eval's injections as drawn

cases.name: noise ×0.5
cases.what: the noise PSD halved (oms and acceleration noise × √0.5); the flow whitens by its own PSD

cases.name: noise ×2
cases.what: the noise PSD doubled (oms and acceleration noise × √2); the flow whitens by its own PSD

cases.name: f0 past the edge
cases.what: the loudest source's f0 a quarter of the guard band past the window's drawable top

cases.name: fdot above the prior
cases.what: the loudest source's log10 fdot 5 sigma above the prior's mean at its f0

cases.name: SNR above the prior
cases.what: the loudest source at 1.5× the prior's 99.9% source SNR

cases.name: one source more
cases.what: a fifth source, one slot of another prior draw
